plans.name: Single hotel
plans.for: A monthly report for each hotel you add, from one hotel upwards.
features: A full report for each hotel every month
Management PDF and technical evidence appendix
The same questions re-tested, with the change since last month
Findings on your website, listings and AI answers, each with its evidence
Your own questions tested, and your review export analysed
Open forum conversations worth joining, with honest wording
Buy as many hotels as you need, and change the number at any time

plans.name: Portfolio
plans.for: For groups and enterprise: every hotel on one dashboard, and each hotel with its own.
features: Everything in Single hotel, for every hotel
A portfolio dashboard with trends across all your hotels
Every hotel also gets its own dashboard, showing only that hotel
Actions tracked hotel by hotel, so you see what has been done
The same price for every extra hotel you add
